contract: class Agent(observation_space, action_space, seed) with act(observation, explore) and observe(observation, action, reward, next_observation, terminated, truncated). Score: mean evaluation return after a fixed training budget on the Gymnasium task
notes: Small CPU training budgets (20k to 40k steps); the papers' multi-million-step runs are not reproduced. MuJoCo tasks need the mujoco package, LunarLander needs gymnasium[box2d].
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
name: LunarLander-v3
description: LunarLander-v3 task evaluated in Evolutionary Discovery of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms via Large Language Models.
paper_metric: mean maximum evaluation episodic return across five training seeds
limitations: No official public runnable implementation verified from the inspected paper. External benchmark code may exist separately.
Official GECCO 2026 release pinned; packaging is incomplete (no requirements.txt or license at the pinned commit) and every evaluation is a full RL training run.
Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.

science_relevance.definition: A task is important to science when it addresses a substantive scientific or real-world problem, and a cited research paper's main objective is to solve that problem or advance understanding of it. The evidence must explain why the problem matters and how the local task represents it. Using a task to evaluate an agent, framework, or general-purpose model, or citing only a benchmark, dataset, or tool, does not establish scientific importance.
